# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_BREAK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An early‑morning breakout above the opening range that also clears intraday VWAP captures the overnight gap‑fill bias and early momentum. This edge exists because overnight gaps often reflect news-driven sentiment that intraday participants fail to fully fade, and VWAP acts as a dynamic fair value filter to avoid buying into weak intraday trends.

## Mechanism

Entry: At any 5‑minute bar between 09:30‑10:30 ET, if price > opening range high (ORH) AND price > intraday VWAP AND volume > 1.5 × average volume of the first 5‑minute bars (09:30‑09:55 ET), enter long at the close of that bar. Exit: Initial stop at the tighter of opening range low (ORL) or 0.5% below entry price. Take profit at 2R (risk-reward) or trail using a 15% chandelier from the high‑water mark. Avoid entries on FOMC days or major news releases (using automation/state/news.json). Ideal when VIX < 20.

2. **Sample bias:** Zero-sample proposal (no historical backtest conducted); high overfit risk due to untested parameters and regime assumptions.

6. **Concentration:** Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days' contribution to P&L.
